frequency_question: How often does the majority party in the U.S. Senate successfully pass its core high-priority ideological electoral/voting bills when they hold chamber control within a given two-year congress?
membership_rule: Includes major partisan electoral reform or voting qualification bills prioritized by Senate leadership; excludes routine appropriations, bipartisan consensus measures, and unvoted committee bills.

multiplier: 3 attempts across recent polarized sessions, 0 floor passages due to internal party vote thresholds and division.
